pepper_bacterial_spot: Apply copper-based bactericide preventively before wet periods. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
pepper_healthy: No action needed. Continue regular watering and monitoring for early signs of disease.
potato_early_blight: Remove and destroy infected lower leaves promptly. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
potato_late_blight: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately, do not compost. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
potato_healthy: No action needed. Continue regular watering and monitoring for early signs of disease.
tomato_bacterial_spot: Apply copper-based bactericide preventively. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_early_blight: Prune and destroy infected lower leaves promptly. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_late_blight: Remove and bag infected plants immediately, do not compost. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_leaf_mold: Increase ventilation and reduce humidity below 85%. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot: Remove and destroy infected lower leaves as soon as spotted. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_spider_mites: Spray leaves (especially undersides) with a strong jet of water to dislodge mites. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_target_spot: Remove and destroy infected leaves and fruit promptly. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus: There is no cure for the virus itself — remove and destroy infected plants. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_mosaic_virus: There is no cure for the virus itself — remove and destroy infected plants. See the full disease profile in-app for organic, chemical, and preventive options.
tomato_healthy: No action needed. Continue regular watering and monitoring for early signs of disease.
